decisions.reason: The authentication and identity delegation service sits close to the core offer, moved up to its own page in 2024, and supports secure integration of GIS into enterprise systems, so it stays.
The open GIS application development framework is a product line at the heart of the firm's open, extensible strategy, so it stays even though it is only mentioned on the website.
The identity service for GIS applications is actively promoted with its own page and launch messaging, and it fits the strategy of integrating with enterprise user management, so it stays.
The consulting workshop is low-cost, builds on existing expertise, generates follow-on project business, and was only launched recently with its own page, so it stays.
